senses.zh_definition: 若指专名 Reddy：印度人名中使用的名称，也可指印度南部的一个社群。输入中的小写词形尚无法确定具体所指。
senses.en_definition: If intended as Reddy, a name used in personal names and for a southern Indian community; the supplied lowercase token remains unidentified.
senses.ms_definition: Jika merujuk kepada Reddy, nama khas yang digunakan dalam nama orang dan sebagai nama suatu komuniti di India Selatan; rujukan bentuk input belum dapat dipastikan.
senses.nuances: 此处仅提供专名解释的可能性，不能据此认定输入词已获 DBP 收录或是 ready 的变体。以下搭配是称呼格式示例，不是已验证的高频搭配。专名与社群用法可参见 [Christ University 学位论文](https://archives.christuniversity.in/disk0/00/00/50/09/01/Binder1.pdf)。

etymology.historical_story: Reddy is documented as the name of a southern Indian community, with a history involving regional identity and social change. That background does not establish what this isolated lowercase token means. Without its original sentence, it could represent a personal name or another reference; assigning it a Malay common-word origin would be speculative. See the [Christ University study](https://archives.christuniversity.in/disk0/00/00/50/09/01/Binder1.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 reddy 想成名牌上的 Reddy；先认名字，再向本人确认读音，别自动联想到 ready。
